changelog:
• Auto-Update on Startup Overhaul: Enabled Auto-Update on Start by default for all devices, eliminating silent skipping on startup.
• Fast Multi-Source Update Pipeline: Update check now queries high-speed global Firebase CDN and GitHub Releases API directly with zero latency, without blocking on local home server connection timeouts.
• Fallback Update Prompt: Added clean 'Update Available' banner dialog when auto-install is toggled off, so users never miss a release.
